datasets.title: Training compute of landmark AI models, 2012-2026 (log scale)
datasets.unit: training compute, FLOP (log scale; values rounded to 3 significant figures)
datasets.source: Epoch AI, all_ai_models.csv (downloaded 2026-10-10; Epoch 'Data on AI models' page, updated Oct. 8, 2026). Data licensed CC BY 4.0. Confidence: Confident = within 3x, Likely = within 10x, Speculative = within 30x. Closed frontier models released in 2026 have no compute estimate in the database and are not plotted.

datasets.title: Epoch AI training-compute growth-rate estimates
datasets.unit: x per year (multiplicative growth in training compute per year)
labels: Notable language models, Jun 2017 to May 2024
Frontier language models, since 2020 (Trends page, Feb 2026)
datasets.source: Epoch AI blog 'Training compute of frontier AI models' (May 28, 2024): notable 4.1x/yr (90% CI 3.7-4.6), frontier 5.3x/yr (90% CI 4.9-5.7), recent frontier 4.2x/yr (90% CI 3.6-4.9), notable LMs 9.5x/yr (90% CI 7.4-12.2), since Feb 2022 4.4x/yr (90% CI 1.5-11.8). Epoch AI 'Trends in AI' page (updated Feb. 5, 2026): frontier LMs 5x/yr since 2020 (90% CI 4x-6x), doubling every 5.2 months.
datasets.notes: The 'Trends' page value (5x/yr since 2020) and the 2024 blog values cover different windows and sample definitions; do not average them. Last row is the most recent Epoch figure; the rest are from the May 2024 post.

facts.claim: Training compute for frontier language models has been growing at 5× per year since 2020 (doubling every 5.2 months).
facts.source: Epoch AI, 'Trends in AI' (updated Feb. 5, 2026); 90% CI 4x to 6x per the page card

facts.claim: Training compute of notable AI models grew about 4.1x per year (90% CI 3.7x to 4.6x) between 2010 and May 2024; frontier models grew 5.3x per year (90% CI 4.9x to 5.7x) over the same period.
facts.source: Epoch AI, 'Training compute of frontier AI models' (May 28, 2024)

facts.claim: Compute used to train recent models grew 4-5x yearly from 2010 to May 2024 (headline summary of the same study).
facts.source: Epoch AI, 'Training compute of frontier AI models grows by 4-5x per year' (May 28, 2024)

facts.claim: Since the last update in Feb 2022, training compute has grown about 4.4x per year (90% CI 1.5x to 11.8x), a very wide interval.
facts.source: Epoch AI, 'Training compute of frontier AI models' (May 28, 2024)

facts.claim: Training compute increased by nearly 8 orders of magnitude from 2012's AlexNet to 2023's GPT-4.
facts.source: Epoch AI, 'Announcing Epoch AI's updated parameter, compute and data trends database' (Oct. 23, 2023)

facts.claim: Epoch's AI models database lists over 3,600 models, from 1950 to the present, each tagged with training compute where estimated; data is CC BY 4.0.
facts.source: Epoch AI, 'Data on AI models' page (page shows 'Updated Oct. 8, 2026')

facts.claim: AlexNet (2012) is estimated at 4.7e17 FLOP and GPT-3 (2020) at 3.14e23 FLOP, a gap of about 6 orders of magnitude in the Epoch database.
facts.source: Epoch AI all_ai_models.csv (downloaded 2026-10-10); computed from the 'Training compute (FLOP)' column
